'''Jurgan Kalta's carbine''' was a very powerful and accurate [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] commissioned by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Jurgan Kalta]] by [[3956 BBY]]. Sometime after Kalta's [[Death/Legends|death]], this carbine came into the hands of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Fazza Utral]].

==Description==
[[Jurgan Kalta]]'s [[Blaster carbine/Legends|carbine]] was much more powerful than a standard [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] carbine, and the two-[[Limb/Legends|handed]] weapon was especially effective against [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. It was also more accurate than the standard carbine,<ref name="kotor" /> although its effective range of twenty-five [[Meter/Legends|meters]] was comparable to more normal designs.<ref name="kotorrange">The ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' game manual states the range of a blaster carbine as twenty-five meters, which is the same as the range for Jurgan Kalta's carbine from the game.</ref> The weapon had a [[Gold/Legends|gold]]-[[Color/Legends|colored]] finish over most of its body, with the exception of the end of the gun [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]], which was [[Silver/Legends|silver]]-colored.<ref name="kotor" />

==History==
The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] Jurgan Kalta,<ref name="kotor" /> who was active before the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]],<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|196|Kalta, Jurgan}}</ref> had a carbine built sometime before [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Death/Legends|death]] from a [[gaxxan brain-slug]],<ref name="kotor" /> which occurred during or before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="kotorcg" /> Kalta viewed the weapon as "amusingly destructive."<ref name="kotor" /> By 3956 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="kotorcg" /> the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Fazza Utral]] owned the weapon. He had the weapon for sale at his [[Hunting Lodge]] for 4,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="kotor" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jurgan Kalta's carbine appeared in the [[2003]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', where it was a unique weapon that the player could purchase from Fazza Utral in the city of Anchorhead on the planet Tatooine. Compared to the standard blaster carbine, the weapon's statistics had large increases to the amount of damage dealt and the attack bonus, as well as a physical damage bonus against droids.<ref name="kotor" />

The ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Prima Games]] contains an entry on the weapon, in which the title is misspelled as "Jurgan Kalta's Combine." It is also misspelled this way in the appendix of the book.<ref name="kotorsg">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> While the game does not state when Jurgan Kalta had his carbine built,<ref name="kotor" /> [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' established that Kalta was active before the Great [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] War,<ref name="TCSWE" /> which occurred in [[3996 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
